site.name: Yaseen
site.tagline: Unstitched fabric, ready-to-wear, and stitching to your measurements

home.heroBody: Choose unstitched fabric and have it stitched to your measurements, or pick something ready to wear. Cash on delivery across Pakistan.
home.step1Body: Choose an unstitched suit and tick “get it stitched”.
home.step2Body: Save a profile once — for yourself or the family — and reuse it every time.
home.step3Body: Neckline, sleeves, trouser cut and finishing, priced as you pick.
home.step4Body: Follow the job from cutting to ready, then it ships to your door.

story.intro: We are a premium clothing brand dedicated to blending high-quality fabrics with personalized custom tailoring.
story.problem: Finding a reliable tailor can often be a frustrating experience filled with delays, sizing errors, and multiple trips to the shop. We started {brand} to take the hassle entirely out of the equation. We source the finest unstitched fabrics and offer a bespoke, in-house tailoring service right on our website.
story.how: Simply choose your favorite fabric, input your exact measurements online, and let our master tailors craft a beautiful, ready-to-wear outfit perfectly fitted to you, delivered straight to your doorstep.
